title: Shrews may grow bigger snouts in winter to cope with cold air
content: Humans turn to heated blankets and fluffy socks to cope with winter, but long-clawed shrews have a very different adaptation: they increase the size of their snouts. Researchers have previously discovered that certain small mammals reversibly shrink their body mass, skull size and brain mass in winter, with regrowth seen in the spring – a strategy that has been named Dehnel's phenomenon. Scientists now say they have documented similar changes in the long-clawed shrew, but have discovered the opposite trend occurs for the snout. 'This is precisely why we termed it the reverse Dehnel's phenomenon,' said Dr Yugo Ikeda, first author of the research from Toyo University in Japan. Writing in the journal Proceedings of the Royal Society B, Ikeda and colleagues describe how they examined 136 skulls from long-clawed shrews, collected in Hokkaido between 1948 and 1988. 'Measuring skull structures in live, wild shrews repeatedly without harming them is practically impossible,' said Ikeda. Tracking 16 measurements by month, they found several changed by month or season – and not in a uniform way. Shrews collected over the winter season, between January and April, were found to have a brain case height 12% smaller than that of younger shrews collected from August to September in their first year of life. However, the height of the snout was 7% larger and its width was 6% greater in shrews collected in winter. The team said these changes were reversible. The researchers suggest a number of explanations for the seasonal change in snout size, including regulating body temperature. Expanding the nasal cavity creates more room for a rich vascular network. When the shrew inhales freezing air, this network efficiently warms it before it reaches the delicate, winter-shrunken brain – helping maintain core cognitive functions. The expansion of the nasal cavity may also boost shrews' ability to sniff out prey such as earthworms.
translation: 人类靠电热毯和毛绒袜来应对冬天，而长爪鼩鼱有一种非常不同的适应方式：它们会增大自己的吻部。研究人员此前发现，某些小型哺乳动物在冬天会可逆地缩小体重、颅骨尺寸和脑质量，到春天再重新生长——这一策略被称为德内尔现象。科学家现在表示，他们在长爪鼩鼱身上记录了类似的变化，但发现吻部的趋势恰恰相反。日本东洋大学该研究第一作者池田悠吾博士说：这正是我们将其称为反向德内尔现象的原因。池田和同事在《皇家学会学报B》上撰文，描述了如何检验1948年至1988年间在北海道采集的136个长爪鼩鼱头骨。池田说：在不伤害它们的情况下反复测量野生活体鼩鼱的颅骨结构，实际上是不可能的。通过按月追踪16项测量数据，他们发现若干项数据随月份或季节而变化，且并非一致变化。1月至4月冬季采集的鼩鼱，其脑颅高度比第一年8月至9月采集的较年轻鼩鼱小12%；然而，冬季采集的鼩鼱吻部高度大7%，宽度大6%。研究团队表示，这些变化是可逆的。研究人员为吻部尺寸的季节性变化提出了若干解释，包括调节体温。扩大鼻腔为丰富的血管网络创造了更多空间。当鼩鼱吸入冰冷的空气时，这个网络会在空气到达脆弱而冬缩的大脑之前高效地加热它，有助于维持核心认知功能。鼻腔的扩大还可能增强鼩鼱嗅出蚯蚓等猎物的能力。

title: Cities make a surprising refuge for threatened UK wildflowers
content: Wildflowers are having a rough time in the countryside, mostly from the onslaught of intensive farming with fertilisers, pesticides and herbicides and less grazing. On top of that, there are building developments, competition from invasive plant species and the climate crisis to contend with. The UK has lost 97% of its wildflower meadows over the last century and over half of the country's native flowers have been in decline for 70 years. But there is a surprising refuge for wild plants – in urban areas. Cities are often stressful environments, but that can help wildflowers by keeping down competition from other plants such as grasses. In fact, wildflowers generally grow best in low-fertility soils which allows them to become established. Cities also have a wonderful variety of specialised habitats and microclimates in nooks and crannies. Gaps in pavements and walls, roadsides, roundabouts, disused railways, the banks of rivers and streams and the soil under urban trees can all provide safe plant havens. Even the most rundown and derelict sites left untouched by humans can be plant refuges, but some of the best environments are where councils deliberately don't use herbicides and restrict mowing to encourage wild plants to become established.
translation: 野花在乡间过得很艰难，主要因为集约化农业使用化肥、杀虫剂和除草剂的冲击，以及放牧减少。此外，还要应对建筑开发、入侵植物物种的竞争和气候危机。过去一个世纪，英国已失去97%的野花草地，全国超过一半的本土花卉已衰退70年。但野生植物有一个出人意料的庇护所——城市地区。城市往往是压力巨大的环境，但这反而有助于野花，因为它压低了草等其他植物的竞争。事实上，野花通常在肥力较低的土壤中长得最好，这使它们得以立足。城市还在各个犄角旮旯里拥有种类繁多的特殊栖息地和小气候。人行道和墙壁的缝隙、路边、环岛、废弃铁路、河溪两岸以及城市树木下的土壤，都可以成为安全的植物庇护所。即便是最破败、最无人问津的废弃场地也能成为植物庇护所，但一些最好的环境，是那些市政会刻意不用除草剂、限制割草以鼓励野生植物扎根的地方。
summary: 集约农业使英国野花草地锐减97%，但城市缝隙与低肥土壤反而成为野花出人意料的庇护所。

title: Harvard to pay $53m over theft and sale of human remains from medical school
content: Harvard University has agreed to pay a $53m settlement to resolve civil lawsuits stemming from the illegal theft and sale of human remains that had been donated to its medical school for scientific research. A former Harvard medical school morgue manager, Cedric Lodge, 58, was sentenced in December last year to eight years in prison after he had pleaded guilty in May to stealing and selling human body parts in a nationwide scheme. Prosecutors said this had involved the theft and sale of organs, skin, brains and dissected heads from cadavers donated to Harvard from 2018 through at least March 2020. His wife was also sentenced for her role in the black market scheme. Lodge took the remains without the knowledge or permission of his employer, the donor, or the donor's family and transported them to his home, where he and his wife would ship them to buyers in other states, according to a US justice department statement. Remains stolen and sold by the Lodges were transported from the morgue in Boston to locations in several states. Many of the remains purchased from Lodge were resold for a profit. As part of the settlement, Harvard Medical School will make a statement to claimant families affirming that Lodge's conduct was morally reprehensible and inconsistent with Harvard's standards, along with a summary of changes made to its Anatomical Gift Program. The school will also establish an annual financial aid scholarship for medical students, which it said is intended in appreciation and in honor of all of its anatomical donors. Affected families began filing lawsuits against Harvard in the summer of 2023. The suits alleged negligence, breach of fiduciary duty and infliction of emotional distress. While Lodge's sentencing concludes the criminal case against him, and the settlement would conclude the civil cases, the process of recovering from this painful incident continues.
translation: 哈佛大学已同意支付5300万美元和解金，以了结因人体遗骸被非法窃取和出售而引发的民事诉讼——这些遗骸是捐赠给其医学院用于科研的。前哈佛医学院停尸房管理员、58岁的塞德里克·洛奇，在5月承认参与一项全国性计划、窃取并出售人体部位后，于去年12月被判处八年监禁。检察官称，这涉及窃取和出售2018年至至少2020年3月期间捐赠给哈佛的尸体的器官、皮肤、大脑和剖开的头颅。他的妻子也因其在黑市计划中的角色被判刑。据美国司法部声明，洛奇在雇主、捐赠者或捐赠者家属不知情或未许可的情况下取走遗骸，并将其运回新罕布什尔州的家中，在那里他与妻子将遗骸寄给其他州的买家。洛奇夫妇窃取和出售的遗骸从波士顿的停尸房被运往多个州的地点。许多从洛奇处购买的遗骸被转售牟利。作为和解的一部分，哈佛医学院将向索赔家属发表声明，确认洛奇的行为在道德上应受谴责、不符合哈佛的标准，并概述其遗体捐赠计划的改革。学校还将为医学生设立年度助学金，称此举是对所有遗体捐赠者表达感激与敬意。受影响家属于2023年夏天开始起诉哈佛，诉状指控其存在过失、违反受托责任并造成精神痛苦。虽然洛奇的判刑了结了他的刑事案件，和解也将了结民事案件，但从这一痛苦事件中恢复的过程仍在继续。

title: Top album releases linked to rise in fatal crashes as 'distracted' drivers access music
content: The release of a new album by Taylor Swift might be a cause for celebration among her fans, but such events have also been linked to a more sombre phenomenon: an increase in fatal car crashes. The team behind a new study say it sheds light on the impact of distracted driving. 'You can't randomise people into using their phones, and drivers rarely volunteer what they were doing in the seconds before a crash,' said Dr Vishal Patel, first author of the study based at Harvard Medical School. 'Album releases give you something closer to an experiment – a day when smartphone use jumps nationally for reasons that have nothing to do with road conditions.' Writing in the journal Jama Network Open, Patel and colleagues report how they focused on the release of 10 major albums, launched between 2017 and 2022, selected for having the highest number of Spotify streams over a single day. The team found streaming volume for the top 200 songs in the US was 43% higher on the date of major album releases compared with the days surrounding the releases. After taking into account the day of the week, federal holidays, and time of year, the researchers found the number of US traffic fatalities showed a relative increase of 15.1% on the date of major album releases. This is equivalent to approximately 182 fatalities attributable to the release days. Patel said the release of a new album could distract drivers because accessing music is a search task, not a single button press. 'You unlock the phone, open the app, find the release, read down a tracklist, tap the right song. That's several seconds of looking at a screen.' The researchers add the rise in traffic fatalities was greater among younger drivers, male drivers, people driving alone, and people driving cars with a built-in infotainment platform.
translation: 泰勒·斯威夫特新专辑的发布或许会让粉丝们欢欣鼓舞，但这类事件也与一个更沉重的现象相关：致命车祸的增加。这项新研究背后的团队表示，它为分心驾驶的影响提供了线索。该研究第一作者、哈佛医学院的维沙尔·帕特尔博士说：你无法随机安排人们使用手机，司机也极少主动说出他们在车祸前几秒做了什么。专辑发布让你更接近一个实验——一个全国智能手机使用率飙升、且与路况毫无关系的日子。帕特尔和同事在《美国医学会网络开放杂志》上撰文，报告了他们如何聚焦于2017年至2022年间发行的10张主要专辑——这些专辑因单日 Spotify 播放量最高而入选。团队发现，在主要专辑发行当天，美国前200首歌曲的流媒体播放量比发行前后几天高出43%。在考虑星期几、联邦假日和一年中时节等因素后，研究人员发现，在主要专辑发行当天，美国交通事故死亡人数相对增加15.1%。这相当于约182起死亡可归因于发行日。帕特尔说，新专辑发布可能分散司机注意力，因为获取音乐是一项搜索任务，而不是按一下按钮。你解锁手机、打开应用、找到新专辑、浏览曲目列表、点选正确的歌曲。这是几秒钟盯屏幕的时间。研究人员补充说，车祸死亡率的上升在年轻司机、男性司机、独自驾驶者以及驾驶带有内置车载娱乐平台汽车的人群中更为明显。
summary: 哈佛研究发现主要专辑发布日全美手机音乐流量激增，致命车祸死亡率上升15.1%，揭示分心驾驶的规模。

title: Block export of 'national treasure' UK fossils, says MP
content: An MP has called on ministers to change export controls so that significant fossils can be classed as national treasures after one of the UK's best collections, unearthed on Dorset beaches, was sold overseas. Last week, a Guardian investigation revealed that an unparalleled collection of fossils from the UK's Jurassic Coast, comprising hundreds of specimens including ichthyosaurs, had been sold to the Natural History Museum in Abu Dhabi for what one source described as an eight-figure sum. The fossils, which belonged to the Dorset-based private collector Chris Moore, were initially offered to the Natural History Museum in London and Museum Wales, but neither institution had the funds to buy them. Senior figures at Lyme Regis Museum have called on ministers to change the way fossil discoveries are recorded and sold. They said they were not informed of the impending sale of Moore's collection or given the opportunity to acquire it. A letter from the director of the museum notes that the UK's cultural goods export controls – intended to give the country an opportunity to retain objects of outstanding national importance – do not cover fossils and other items of natural history because they are not made. This means that some important and rare fossils can be sold without an export licence. The West Dorset fossil collecting code of conduct notes that on the rapidly eroding coast, fossil collecting is essential if specimens are to be saved from damage or destruction by the sea. Evans and the museum director want fossils of exceptional scientific or national significance to be covered by the Waverley criteria – three benchmarks used to determine whether an object is classed as a national treasure. If at least one of the criteria is met, a temporary export bar can be imposed, giving UK museums time to raise the money needed to acquire an object.
translation: 在英国最好的化石收藏之一——在多塞特海滩出土——被售往海外之后，一位议员呼吁部长们修改出口管制，使重要化石能够被列为国宝。上周，《卫报》的一项调查披露，一批来自英国侏罗纪海岸的无与伦比的化石收藏——包括鱼龙在内的数百件标本——已被出售给阿布扎比自然历史博物馆，据消息人士称成交价为八位数。这些化石属于多塞特私人收藏家克里斯·摩尔，最初曾提供给伦敦自然历史博物馆和威尔士博物馆，但两家机构都无力购买。莱姆里吉斯博物馆的资深人士呼吁部长们改变化石发现记录和出售的方式。他们说，他们既未被告知摩尔收藏即将出售，也没有机会收购它。博物馆馆长的一封信指出，英国的文化商品出口管制——本意是让国家有机会保留具有杰出国家重要性的物品——并不涵盖化石和其他自然历史物品，因为它们不是制造出来的。这意味着一些重要而稀有的化石可以在没有出口许可证的情况下出售。西多塞特化石采集行为守则指出，在侵蚀迅速的海岸上，如果要使标本免遭海水损坏或破坏，采集化石至关重要。埃文斯和博物馆馆长希望具有特殊科学或国家意义的化石被纳入韦弗利标准——用于判断一件物品是否可列为国宝的三项基准。只要满足其中至少一项，就可以实施临时出口禁令，给英国博物馆时间筹集收购所需资金。
summary: 英国侏罗纪海岸顶级化石收藏被售往阿布扎比，议员呼吁将化石纳入国宝出口管制以保护自然遗产。

title: 'A tax on being thin': only high earners make savings on food bills from weight-loss drugs
content: The high cost of weight-loss medication is a regressive tax on being thin because the outlay outweighs any saving on food costs for all but the highest earners. Someone needs to have discretionary income of nearly £100,000 a year to actually save money after covering the £1,200 annual cost of GLP-1 medication, according to an analysis by the consultancy Baringa. 'Our analysis shows that GLP-1s risk becoming a driver of inequality,' said Paddy Winters, a partner at Baringa. 'Only very high earners will benefit from savings to their groceries whilst taking the GLP-1 pill.' A regressive tax is one that takes a larger percentage from lower-wage earners' income compared with those who are more wealthy. Most users buy the drugs with a private prescription. A GLP-1 user with £39,000 left over after tax and essentials will spend £481 less a year on food. But it is not until someone has £97,500 left to spend after tax and other outgoings that their grocery spend is reduced by £1,200, according to Baringa. For everyone else the annual cost of the drug outweighs any reduction in spending on groceries, Winters said. On top of that, users are spending more on vitamin supplements and personal care products to manage side effects. In effect, GLP-1s become a regressive tax on being thin. We're already seeing early signs that some people cancel their prescription after a few months because the cost adds up – but the weight comes back once you stop. It is estimated that 5% of adults in Britain are on weight-loss medication, while 9% have taken it at some point. It expects this number to rise to 13% by the end of next year. About 60% of GLP-1 users are women. Among current users 6% come from households with income of less than £20,000, whereas 20% are from the wealthiest, earning above £100,000.
translation: 减肥药的高昂成本是一种对变瘦的累退税，因为除了最高收入者外，药物支出超过了任何食品开支上的节省。咨询公司贝灵的分析显示，一个人需要拥有近10万英镑的年可支配收入，才能在支付每年1200英镑的 GLP-1 药物费用后真正省钱。贝灵合伙人帕迪·温特斯说：我们的分析显示，GLP-1 类药物有成为不平等驱动因素的风险。只有非常高的收入者才能在服用 GLP-1 药片的同时从食品杂货的节省中获益。累退税是指与较富裕者相比，从低收入者收入中扣除比例更大的税种。大多数用户通过私人处方购买这些药物。一个税后扣除必需品后剩3.9万英镑的 GLP-1 用户，每年在食品上会少花481英镑。但据贝灵称，只有当一个人税后及其他支出后剩9.75万英镑可花时，其食品杂货开支才会减少1200英镑。温特斯说，对其他所有人而言，药物的年成本都超过了食品杂货开支的任何减少。此外，用户还要花更多钱购买维生素补充剂和护发等个人护理产品来管理副作用。实际上，GLP-1 类药物成了对变瘦的累退税。我们已经看到一些早期迹象：有人在几个月后因费用累积而取消处方——但一旦停药，体重就会反弹。据估计，英国5%的成年人正在服用减肥药，9%的人曾服用过。预计到明年年底，这一数字将升至13%。约60%的 GLP-1 使用者是女性。在现有使用者中，6%来自收入低于2万英镑的家庭，而20%来自收入超过10万英镑的最富裕人群。
summary: GLP-1 减肥药年费高，只有年可支配收入近10万英镑者才能省下食品开支，恐成加剧健康不平等的新因素。

需9.75万可支配收入才能省1200英镑，低收入者更易停药反弹

hard.t: 减肥药的高昂成本是一种对变瘦的累退税，因为除了最高收入者外，药物支出超过了任何食品开支上的节省。

title: Scientists who turned to OnlyFans to fund marmot research receive crypto boost
content: Scientists who turned to OnlyFans to help save long-running research into marmots have raised more than $100,000 after harnessing the support of another, very modern, funding avenue – cryptocurrency. The 60-year project of continuous study of marmots across the US west was facing termination following science funding cuts imposed by Donald Trump's administration. In desperation, researchers in June decided to put the marmots on OnlyFans to raise funds. Since then, posts on the new account have shown marmots scurrying across rocky landscapes and entering their burrows, rather than anything sexually explicit. 'Our goal isn't really to sexualise the marmots,' said Daniel Blumstein, a professor at UCLA. 'It's to celebrate the marmots.' This effort has raised a modest $6,000 but a further, much larger, funding boost has recently materialized in the form of a new marmot-themed cryptocurrency. A new meme coin named $OnlyMarms was created by outside supporters who donated all transaction fees to the study. This marmot memecoin, a type of cryptocurrency based on online culture and memes that fluctuates in price based on viral trends, has raised more than $88,000 in just two weeks. Along with outside donations from marmot allies who were uncomfortable donating through the OnlyFans platform, the research program has gained more than $100,000 in funding, enabling it to continue for a further year. 'It's been a crazy last two weeks, it's been incredible to see and it's a relief that the research can continue for another year,' said Julien Martin, a University of Ottawa researcher who co-leads the project. While the marmots are not in any imminent danger of extinction, they are being affected by the climate crisis. The researchers have seen them increase in body mass as the summers get longer and the winters get shorter. But the other aspect is a record lack of snowfall in Colorado and a big die-off of marmots, more than ever before. The snow cover arrived so late and the extent was so small. The marmots need the snow as a layer of insulation as they hibernate in their burrows, so without this many of them just froze to death.
translation: 为拯救一项历时悠久的土拨鼠研究而转向 OnlyFans 的科学家们，在借助另一种非常现代的筹资渠道——加密货币——后，已筹集超过10万美元。这项横跨美国西部的60年连续土拨鼠研究项目，因唐纳德·特朗普政府削减科研经费而面临终止。绝望之下，研究人员6月决定把土拨鼠放到 OnlyFans 上筹款。此后，新账号上的帖子展示的是土拨鼠在岩石地貌间奔跑、钻入洞穴的画面，而非任何露骨内容。加州大学洛杉矶分校教授丹尼尔·布卢姆斯坦说：我们的目标不是真的把土拨鼠色情化，而是庆祝土拨鼠。这项工作筹集了不多不少6000美元，但最近一笔大得多的资助以一种新型土拨鼠主题加密货币的形式出现。外部支持者创建了一种名为$OnlyMarms的模因币，并将全部交易费捐给这项研究。这种土拨鼠模因币——一种基于网络文化和模因、价格随病毒式趋势波动的加密货币——仅两周就筹集了超过8.8万美元。再加上那些不愿通过 OnlyFans 平台捐款的土拨鼠盟友的外部捐赠，该项目已获得超过10万美元资金，得以再延续一年。共同领导该项目的渥太华大学研究员朱利安·马丁说：过去两周疯狂极了，看到这一切令人难以置信，研究能再继续一年让人如释重负。虽然土拨鼠暂无灭绝之虞，但它们正受到气候危机的影响。研究人员看到，随着夏季变长、冬季变短，它们的体重增加了。但另一方面，科罗拉多州遭遇创纪录的降雪缺失，土拨鼠出现前所未有的死亡。降雪来得太晚、范围太小。土拨鼠冬眠在洞穴中需要雪作为保温层，因此没有雪，许多土拨鼠就冻死了。
summary: 科研经费被砍后，科学家用 OnlyFans 和模因币为60年土拨鼠研究筹得10万美元，同时记录气候危机对动物的影响。

structure.summary: 经费被砍后上 OnlyFans 展示土拨鼠，仅筹6000美元
$OnlyMarms 模因币两周筹8.8万，项目得以延续一年
长期监测揭示气候危机影响：体重变化与无雪冬季大量死亡

hard.t: 为拯救一项历时悠久的土拨鼠研究而转向 OnlyFans 的科学家们，在借助另一种非常现代的筹资渠道——加密货币——后，已筹集超过10万美元。

hard.s: The marmots need the snow as a layer of insulation as they hibernate in their burrows, so without this many of them just froze to death.
hard.t: 土拨鼠冬眠在洞穴中需要雪作为保温层，因此没有雪，许多土拨鼠就冻死了。

title: Monstera magic: Barbican hands out cuttings as 'green lung of the city' closes
content: Above the waxy monstera leaves and bright pink hibiscus flowers in the Barbican conservatory hangs a giant net to catch the panes of glass that are at risk of falling from the ceiling on the unwitting plant lovers below. This precarious situation has caused the estate to shutter its greenhouse for three years so a full refurbishment can take place. But the hiatus has a silver lining for many of those who visited on Wednesday to give the plants from the conservatory a new home. Five hundred people turned up to pick up a cutting from the Barbican's plant collection and were asked to fill out an adoption form as if they were taking home a pet. Lydia Goldberg, 56, a tech worker, was one of the first through the door and selected a pretty, silvery-green Swedish ivy plant. 'I am a houseplant lover. I live in the Barbican and my bedroom overlooks the conservatory. I am sad to see it close but it's great that it's being restored. Having a piece of the conservatory in my flat will be incredible and this is a real community event.' There are going to be three adoption events, each giving away 500 cuttings from species in the conservatory. The first, held this week, ran out of free online tickets almost immediately. Part of the head gardener's job is to figure out which plants will remain indoors and which will go outside. The climate has changed considerably since the Barbican was built in the 1960s and many indoor plants are now outdoor plants. Some of the plants are a bit rough around the edges after the weather we have had. London has sizzled in five heatwaves and the climate control in the conservatory has not caught up. When we have new climate control and irrigation systems, the plants will be healthier. The event was bittersweet, as most people were rueful that the space will be shut for such a long stretch. Dr Philippa Simpson, the chief operating officer of the Barbican, feels keenly the responsibility of faithfully restoring the conservatory. 'It's a green lung of the city. We have nets up to deal with falling glazing, massive waterproofing issues. It is leaking into all of our significant spaces.' When the conservatory reopens in 2030, it will be fully accessible and will be open seven days a week.
translation: 巴比肯温室里蜡质的龟背竹叶和亮粉色木槿花上方，悬挂着一张巨大的网，用来接住可能从天花板坠落的玻璃窗格，保护下方毫不知情的植物爱好者。这种危险状况使这个综合体决定关闭其温室三年，以便进行全面翻新。但对周三前来为温室植物寻找新家的许多人来说，这段空档期也有其积极的一面。500人前来领取巴比肯植物收藏的插枝，并被要求填写一份领养表，就像把宠物带回家一样。56岁的科技工作者莉迪亚·戈德伯格是第一批进门的人之一，她挑选了一株漂亮的银绿色瑞典常春藤。她说：我是室内植物爱好者。我住在巴比肯，卧室正对着温室。看到它关闭我很伤心，但很高兴它正在被修复。把温室的一部分带回公寓将令人难以置信，这是一场真正的社区活动。将有三场领养活动，每场赠送500枝温室物种的插枝。本周举行的第一场，免费线上门票几乎瞬间被抢光。首席园丁的部分工作，是弄清楚哪些植物留在室内、哪些搬到室外。自20世纪60年代巴比肯建成以来，气候发生了巨大变化，许多室内植物如今成了室外植物。经历这样的天气后，一些植物有点蓬头垢面。伦敦已在五次热浪中炙烤，温室的气候控制系统还没跟上。等我们有了新的气候控制和灌溉系统，植物会更健康。这场活动苦乐参半，因为大多数人对这个空间将关闭这么久感到惋惜。巴比肯首席运营官菲利帕·辛普森博士深切感到忠实修复温室的责任。它是城市的一叶绿肺。我们架起网来应对坠落的玻璃，还有大规模防水问题。它正漏进我们所有重要的空间。当温室在2030年重新开放时，它将完全无障碍，并将每周开放七天，而非限定时段。
summary: 巴比肯温室因玻璃坠落风险闭馆翻新，500人排队领养植物插枝；气候变暖也让许多室内植物转为室外。

title: Wetherspoons customers welcome ban on loud phones
content: At Wetherspoons, the convivial atmosphere can no longer be punctuated by rude customers taking phone calls on blast, or playing videos without headphones after Tim Martin, the owner of the pub chain, banned both on his premises. Gary and Mark, brothers who were catching up over pints, both thought anyone playing loud sounds in the pub should be barred. 'There is no way anyone should be allowed to be obnoxious enough to have their phone on loud. Why should people choose to play music that I don't like and that other people around them don't like?' asked Mark. 'I listen to music with headphones on, in a private way.' But Gary pointed out: 'First they didn't used to allow televisions in Wetherspoons but now they have TVs with the sound on. External noise is becoming part of the pub.' The company announced on Tuesday it had introduced the ban across its 792 pubs, saying sound from smartphones and tablets had become an increasing problem in recent years. 'In a world dominated by other people's music and amplified sound, Wetherspoons pubs are an oasis of tranquillity and contemplation,' Martin said. 'We are kindly asking phone users to pipe down.' The pub company has recently been clamping down on some modern behaviours – including banning the use of Meta's spy glasses to record inside pubs. The glasses contain very small cameras that enable the wearer to discreetly film. Students agreed it was antisocial and inconsiderate to play video and phone calls out loud in the pub, but said they weren't regularly troubled by it. A worker said: 'I think it's a great idea. People have loud speakerphone conversations right next to you and you can't enjoy your pint. In a pub, you don't want that. I take my phone calls outside.' Not everyone had got the memo. 'Someone was doing it just now, taking a loud call on speakerphone; it annoys me and it is inconsiderate,' said one customer. The manager of one pub said she had had to tell people to turn off the sound on their phones on a number of occasions. 'Some people understand when we ask them to turn off the noise – others are looking for a fight.'
translation: 在 Wetherspoons 酒吧，友好欢乐的氛围将不再被粗鲁顾客开免提打电话或无耳机播放视频所打断——此前，这家连锁酒吧的老板蒂姆·马丁在其门店禁止了这两种行为。正在喝着啤酒叙旧的兄弟俩加里和马克都认为，任何在酒吧里大声放声音的人都应被禁止入内。马克问：绝不应该允许任何人厚颜到把手机开到最大声。为什么人们要播放我不喜欢、周围人也不喜欢的音乐？我听音乐都用耳机，很私密。但加里指出：起初 Wetherspoons 不允许放电视，现在他们有了带声音的电视。外部噪音正成为酒吧的一部分。该公司周二宣布，已在旗下792家酒吧推行这一禁令，称智能手机和平板电脑的声音近年来已成为日益严重的问题。马丁说：在一个被他人音乐和放大声音主导的世界里，Wetherspoons 酒吧是一片宁静沉思的绿洲。我们恳请手机使用者放低音量。这家酒吧公司近期一直在打击某些现代行为——包括禁止使用 Meta 的间谍眼镜在酒吧内拍摄。这种眼镜含有非常小的摄像头，佩戴者可以暗中拍摄。学生们认为在酒吧里大声播放视频和打电话是反社会、不为他人着想的，但表示自己并不经常被此困扰。一位工人说：我觉得这是个好主意。人们就在你身边用免提大声打电话，你都没法好好喝自己的啤酒。在酒吧里，没人想要这个。我都是到外面接电话。但并非所有人都收到了通知。刚才就有人这么做，开着免提大声打电话；这让我恼火，也太不为别人着想了，一位顾客说。一家酒吧的经理表示，她不得不多次叫人们关掉手机声音。我们请他们关掉噪音时，有些人能理解——另一些人则想找茬打架。
summary: Wetherspoons 酒吧全面禁止免提打电话和播放视频，顾客普遍叫好，认为公共空间的噪音侵扰该被约束。

title: Introducing Ulez was my hardest decision as mayor – but now we know its impact
content: When I introduced London's clean air zone – the ultra-low emission zone (Ulez) – more than seven years ago, no city had ever attempted anything quite like it. At the time, the scheme in central London provoked fierce opposition. When I decided to expand it, first in 2021 to inner London, and then again in 2023 to the whole city, making it the biggest clean-air zone in the world – my detractors were louder still. I had, they claimed, declared war on drivers in blind pursuit of a policy that may not even work. In recent years, though, those critics have gone quiet. There is now a mountain of evidence to show that the Ulez has slashed air pollution across London, and research published by Imperial College London earlier this year showed that this is already saving lives. Between 2019 and 2024, estimated deaths associated with air pollution in the capital fell by around 40%. A new study published by Queen Mary University of London shows how the Ulez is improving the lungs and lives of London's children. Young children are the first to feel the impact of air pollution. They breathe faster than adults, and more often through their mouths, allowing more pollution to pass into their bodies. Their heads are lower to the ground, too, meaning they're closer to vehicle exhausts. And, because they're still growing, long-term exposure to air pollution can do lasting damage to their development. Researchers tracked the lung growth of more than 3,400 children in Luton and central London, beginning in 2019 and concluding five years later. Before the Ulez, children in the capital had significantly poorer lung function than children in Luton. But across the five-year period, children's exposure to NO2 fell twice as fast in London as it did in Luton. And when scientists measured lung function again, young Londoners' lungs had caught up. The proportion of children in London with clinically impaired lung function fell from 14% to 9%. Though there's more to be done, it's clear that cleaning up the capital's air has changed young Londoners' lives for the better.
translation: 七年前我推出伦敦清洁空气区——超低排放区（Ulez）时，还没有任何城市尝试过类似的做法。当时，伦敦市中心的这一计划引发了强烈反对。当我决定扩大它——先在2021年扩至内伦敦，2023年再扩至全城，使其成为世界上最大的清洁空气区——我的批评者声音更大了。他们声称，我是在盲目追求一项可能根本不管用的政策，向司机宣战。不过近年来，这些批评者安静下来了。现在有大量证据表明，Ulez 已大幅削减了伦敦的空气污染，帝国理工学院今年早些时候发表的研究显示，这已经在拯救生命。2019年至2024年间，伦敦与空气污染相关的估计死亡人数下降了约40%。伦敦玛丽女王大学发表的一项新研究显示，Ulez 正在改善伦敦儿童的肺部健康和生命。幼儿最先感受到空气污染的影响。他们比成人呼吸更快，且更常通过嘴巴呼吸，使更多污染物进入体内。他们的头也更接近地面，意味着更靠近车辆尾气。而且，由于仍在发育，长期暴露于空气污染会对他们的发育造成持久伤害。研究人员追踪了卢顿和伦敦市中心3400多名儿童的肺活量增长，从2019年开始，五年后结束。在 Ulez 推出前，首都儿童的肺功能明显差于卢顿儿童。但在五年期间，伦敦儿童接触二氧化氮的降幅是卢顿的两倍。当科学家再次测量肺功能时，伦敦年轻一代的肺部已经追了上来。伦敦儿童中肺功能临床受损的比例从14%降至9%。尽管还有更多工作要做，但显然，净化首都空气已让伦敦年轻人的生活变得更好。
summary: 伦敦市长回顾 Ulez 推行历程：虽曾遭强烈反对，但证据显示空气污染大降、儿童肺功能追赶上来，决策被证明正确。

hard.s: When I decided to expand it, first in 2021 to inner London, and then again in 2023 to the whole city, making it the biggest clean-air zone in the world – my detractors were louder still.

hard.s: They breathe faster than adults, and more often through their mouths, allowing more pollution to pass into their bodies.
